🧪 Tested in Japan & France
8.8

Holiday Video Camera Rating

The most beautiful camera you can own. Stunning photos, capable video, and film simulations that eliminate editing.

The Fujifilm X100VI is a camera that makes you want to shoot. With its retro rangefinder design, 40MP sensor, and legendary film simulations, it's as much a fashion statement as a tool.

Key Specifications

Sensor40MP APS-C X-Trans
Lens23mm f/2 (35mm equiv)
Video6.2K30, 4K60
StabilizationIn-body 5-axis
Weight521g
Price$1,599

🎞️ Film Simulations

Fujifilm's film simulations (Velvia, Classic Chrome, Acros, etc.) are the best in-camera color profiles available. In Japan, I shot entire days using Classic Chrome and delivered edited-looking photos straight from camera.

🎬 Video Capabilities

6.2K30 and 4K60 with 10-bit internal recording is impressive for a compact camera. The built-in ND filter lets you shoot wide open in bright light for cinematic shallow depth of field.

❌ The Fixed Lens Limitation

35mm equivalent is versatile but limiting. No zoom means you walk to compose. For travel, this forces creativity but misses some shots.

✅ Buy if:

  • You value aesthetics and ergonomics
  • You shoot photos AND video
  • You want in-camera color perfection

❌ Skip if:

  • You need zoom flexibility
  • You're on a budget
  • You want the lightest camera
